verdict.rationale: Xero has an official accounting API with SDKs and an OpenAPI spec covering general-ledger data. It also ships an official MCP server and an AI toolkit (OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain), so an agent can plausibly write accounting records. However, nothing in the evidence shows journal-entry creation through the API, or a draft state or review queue for agent-posted journals. The only draft-for-approval evidence covers AI-extracted bills, not journals. missing for 10: documented manual-journal create endpoint or MCP tool, draft/review-queue status for API-posted journals, accountant approval workflow for journals, hands-on corroboration.
